sources.title: Linkup - Linkup has achieved SOTA performance
sources.snippet: Linkup has achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on OpenAI's SimpleQA benchmark, scoring 90.10%. This performance surpasses both traditional AI models (e.g. Grok 3) and competing web-connected solutions (e.g. Perplexity)
